hero.subtitle: Lumivox is an AI study planner for students that combines task planning, focus sessions, behavioral analytics, and personalized AI-assisted recommendations in one workspace.
hero.secondaryCta: See how AI study planning works

features.subtitle: Six quiet superpowers, designed to remove friction from learning and replace it with momentum.

behavioralAnalytics.title: Behavioral analytics
behavioralAnalytics.desc: We learn from your sessions, breaks and energy patterns to surface when you do your best work.

aiRecommendations.title: AI recommendations
aiRecommendations.desc: A gentle coach that suggests what to study next, how long to focus, and when to truly rest.

focusMode.title: Immersive focus mode
focusMode.desc: Calm timers, ambient rooms and distraction shields turn any moment into deep work.

goalTasks.title: Goal-linked tasks
goalTasks.desc: Every task maps to a long-term goal, so progress always feels meaningful, not mechanical.

studyRooms.title: Live study rooms
studyRooms.desc: Sit beside other learners in themed rooms - presence, not pressure.

rewards.title: Streaks and rewards
rewards.desc: Earn tokens, protect streaks with shields, and unlock cozy themes as you grow.

howItWorks.title: From scattered to focused - in three quiet steps

capture.title: Capture your intentions
capture.desc: Drop tasks, link them to goals, or let AI break a big project into bite-sized steps.

focus.title: Enter calm focus
focus.desc: Pick an ambient room, set a timer, and let Lumivox quietly track what helps you flow.

patterns.title: Learn from your patterns
patterns.desc: See your best hours, your friction points, and AI suggestions to keep your week balanced.

analytics.title: Patterns you can finally see
analytics.desc: Review focus trends, task completion, deadline behavior, and interpretable PBI components without turning activity into a vanity score.
analytics.imageAlt: Lumivox behavioral analytics dashboard showing focus trends and study patterns

items.energy: Spot subjects that drain or energize you
items.rewards: Track streaks, shields, and tokens earned

focus.title: A timer that respects your attention
focus.desc: Run intentional focus sessions and record the actual time and distractions that shape your behavioral history.
focus.imageAlt: Lumivox focus-session interface with timer and session controls

rooms.title: Quietly study - together
rooms.desc: Create or join shared study spaces with presence, chat, voice participation, and group challenges.
rooms.imageAlt: Lumivox study room showing collaborative study controls and live presence

researchEvidence.title: Research-backed behavioral intelligence
researchEvidence.description: Lumivox evaluates task-delay risk with a versioned native classifier. Every number below comes from the held-out test evaluation, not from a student-outcome claim.

snapshots.label: Task snapshots
snapshots.description: Samples in the native modeling dataset.

recall.label: Test recall
recall.description: Late tasks identified on the held-out set.

researchEvidence.source: Native task-risk model v2 - held-out test evaluation

trust.title: Useful signals, with their limits visible
trust.description: Behavioral data supports planning and reflection. Lumivox documents what is processed, where AI is involved, and why predictions should remain decision support.
trust.cta: Read Lumivox privacy and data use

purpose.title: Purpose-limited data
purpose.description: Tasks, goals, focus records, and selected context support the features that use them.

assistance.title: AI as assistance
assistance.description: Recommendations and risk estimates may be wrong and should be reviewed by the learner.

transparency.title: Evidence in context
transparency.description: Model, usability, and platform metrics are labeled separately with their source.

control.title: Protected access
control.description: Supabase authentication and row-level policies scope application access to relevant records.

free.question: Is Lumivox free to use?
free.answer: Lumivox is currently free to explore as a university project. No paid plan or subscription is advertised on this site.

coach.question: How does the AI coach work?
coach.answer: It quietly observes your focus sessions, completions and break patterns, then recommends what to study next, ideal session length, and when to rest.

privacy.question: Is my data private?
privacy.answer: Access to application records is protected by authentication and row-level policies. Some AI features send selected context to configured model providers; read the privacy page for the current implementation details.

friends.question: Can I study with friends?
friends.answer: Yes. Study rooms support shared presence, chat, voice participation, reactions, and group challenges.

cta.title: Build a calmer, more measurable study routine with Lumivox.
cta.subtitle: Plan your work, focus with intention, and learn from your own behavioral patterns with AI-assisted recommendations.

footer.description: Calm intelligence for your study - behavioral analytics and AI recommendations for the next generation of learners.
